# A song whose length comes in a while after its name (as browsers and some Linux players send it), fix/lookup127
# (1280x720, 1.21.11, the demo song, World layout, the bar's lyric line on, song name only on change: the defaults).
# The test hook's "songlength 0" has the demo report no length; "song" then starts a made-up song with no length, and
# "songlength 78" brings the length in mid-line. Each shot, the branch against the old code:
# 1. lookup127-before (about 21 s into the song, the line "Neon skyline, can you hear it"): the bar shows that line and
#    the first World words of it are up. The same on both.
# 2. lookup127-after_00..05 (1.5 seconds right after the length comes in, still the same line; the first frame or two
#    can be from before the tracker's next read, the same on both). On the old code the bar goes back to
#    "Late Length · SkyLyrics Demo" (for 3.5 s) in place of the line being sung, and the World words of the line vanish
#    at once, the last few sung coming back together, arriving anew. On the branch the bar keeps the line, and the
#    words stay where they are, the next ones joining them one by one.
# 3. lookup127-later (about 26 s, the next line "Every word is written in the stars"): the bar shows the line and the
#    words of it, the same on both.
# What the demo can't show: with a real player the old code also faded the lyrics out and back in while the song was
# looked up again (the demo's lyrics never need a lookup). That part is checked by tests only (LateDetailsTest).
# Run it, and with -f mod_ref=fix/lookup127-red (main plus the songlength hook alone) to compare with the old code:
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/lookup127 -f version=1.21.11 -f script=.github/checks/lookup127.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref fix/lookup127 -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/lookup127-red -f script=.github/checks/lookup127.txt

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set layout WORLD
set barLyrics true
set hudOnlyOnChange true
look 0 -10
sleep 8

songlength 0
sleep 1
song Late Length | SkyLyrics Demo
sleep 4.5
seek 20
sleep 1.2
shot lookup127-before
songlength 78
burst lookup127-after 6 250
sleep 3
shot lookup127-later
song
songlength 78
